csv_project_name: Consultant for Safety Action Plan - River Valley Region
csv_scope_of_work: The River Valley Regional Commission (RVRC) invites qualified consulting firms to submit written proposals to provide a systemic analysis that identifies safety focus areas and develops a roadway design counter measure toolbox to aid in the development of a regional Comprehensive Safety Action Plan for the River Valley Region. This planning effort is the result of the USDOT Safe Streets and Roads for All (SS4A) discretionary grant program which awarded funds to RVRC
